propositions: The explicit intercept selection ladder and 13 duplicate literal policy frozensets in the router have been removed, with policy sets now derived solely from _registry.derive_policy_sets()
Every command route (21 intercepts plus audit) now carries exactly one lazy handler, argv adapter, and init policy, dispatching through a single _execute.execute function
Both CLI help and reference generators pass --check validation byte-identically on second render, confirming no unapproved changes to help/overview or argv output
All behavioral contracts including exit codes, output, init policies, confirmation sets, and aliases are preserved across the entire command suite via subprocess E2E tests
Source modules _cli/__init__.py (340 LOC) and _registry.py (754 LOC) remain under 800-line limits with no mechanically-split files under 100 lines
Migration is code-only with no persisted storage format or data changes; reverting code restores the old router state
